step 12: load ip_tables
  daemon: load ip_tables now, which the host's iptables uses and dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh needs loaded before it installs the user's daemon
  run:
    $ modprobe ip_tables

step 13: load br_netfilter at boot
  daemon: list br_netfilter and ip_tables in /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf, shared by every admitted deployment
  write /etc/modules-load.d/paisans.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit. The rootless Docker daemons of admitted
    | # deployments need br_netfilter to start with their userland proxy off,
    | # and the module their iptables uses for the setup tool to install them.
    | br_netfilter
    | ip_tables

  Other sites dial this one, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's route rule relays the mesh, and its forward policy governs every other route.
